Name:           multisource
Version:        2.3.4
Release:        1.fc42
Summary:        A test package with multiple sources
License:        MIT
URL:            https://example.com/multisource
Source0:        https://example.com/multisource/multisource-2.3.4.tar.gz
Source1:        https://example.com/multisource/extra-data.tar.gz
Source2:        https://example.com/multisource/patches.tar.gz
Source3:        https://example.com/multisource/vendor-2.3.4.tar.gz

%description
A test package with several Source declarations, including macro-based URLs.

%prep
cd '/home/shebert/rpmbuild/BUILD/multisource-2.3.4-build'
rm -rf 'multisource-2.3.4'
/usr/lib/rpm/rpmuncompress -x 'tests/fixtures/specs/multisource-2.3.4.tar.gz'
STATUS=$?
if [ $STATUS -ne 0 ]; then
  exit $STATUS
fi
cd 'multisource-2.3.4'
/usr/bin/chmod -Rf a+rX,u+w,g-w,o-w .


%build

%install

%files

%changelog
* Mon Jan 01 2024 Test <test@example.com> - 2.3.4-1
- Initial package
